description: The RFC 8785 property-name sorting sample. The discriminating pair is U+1F602 (UTF-16 D83D DE02) against U+FB33: UTF-16 code-unit order puts the astral character FIRST, while a Unicode code-point sort - which is what json.dumps(sort_keys=True) performs - puts U+FB33 first and is wrong.
source:
{

  "1": "One",
  "\u0080": "Control\u007f",
  "\ud83d\ude02": "Smiley",
  "\u00f6": "Latin Small Letter O With Diaeresis",
  "\ufb33": "Hebrew Letter Dalet With Dagesh",
  "</script>": "Browser Challenge"
}
